newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Kabila rule out Zaire ceasefire this week.
newsitem.headline: Kabila rule out Zaire ceasefire this week.

text.p: Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila said on Sunday the rebels would fight on while President Mobutu Sese Seko considers their demand he resign.

"Mobutu has asked me to give him eight days while he considers our demand to resign. I have agreed to that request and we shall meet again on this same ship within the next eight days. But I have told him and the mediators that there will be no ceasefire while he considers our demands," he told Reuters.
Kabila, speaking to Reuters in Lubumbashi by telephone from the South African navy ship where he met Mobutu on Sunday, said his forces were now aiming at Kinshasa's international airport.
Mobutu wants to hand over power to a transitional authority other than the rebels. The rebels say Kabila should take power.

Kabila leads the Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo-Zaire which has captured more than three quarters of the vast country in seven months. Mobutu's forces have hardly put up any resistance to their rapid advance.
A mining manager on Sunday quoted his office in Kinshasa as saying the rebels were within 40 miles (65 km) of Kinshasa airport and had taken a large town southwest of the capital.
